gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gantari: Balsamiq Sans draws every line like a channel cut through stencil board, with no pinched curves anywhere. Gantari goes the other way, bending thin and wirelike through each word, so the loud heading gets the shouting and the body gets the talking.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gayathri: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans leads with a line you could trace. Gayathri follows in a sans that thins gently, like a letterpress slug, with open-ended curves that never turn spindly beside the heavier heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-google-sans: Google Sans keeps its strokes uniform, with terminals pulled well back. Balsamiq Sans is the one to make a loud, hand-cut statement, while Google Sans quietly handles the explaining in a smooth sans with no thick-thin shifts.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-google-sans-flex: Balsamiq Sans holds one constant weight, like a stencil-cut channel, and never pinches a curve anywhere in the line. Google Sans Flex reads smoothly, each curve ending in a clean gap.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gothic-a1: Balsamiq Sans has zero modulation in its line, a stencil-cut channel of constant weight that stays bold and expressive throughout. Gothic A1 brings a splayed c terminal and a gentle low contrast, which is the pairing's best trait.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gotu: Chunky, hand-cut and loud: Balsamiq Sans builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, while Gotu slims noticeably yet stays sturdy. Over a long passage, Gotu's open-mouthed e crossbars keep the reading easy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gowun-dodum: Gowun Dodum looks smooth, almost tube-like, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Balsamiq Sans does the bold, expressive work of a display line, while Gowun Dodum does the quiet job of carrying text in a plain sans.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gruppo: Balsamiq Sans moves with a constant weight, so reading it feels like following a single thread through the heading. Gruppo, a plain sans, keeps its curve endings well apart and its contrast low.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gudea: Gudea reads approachably modern, its curves as thick as a drawn thread and its terminals glass-clear against the stroke. Gudea can stay at a modest size without losing clarity, while Balsamiq Sans carries the bold, stencil-cut statement above.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-hanken-grotesk: Expressive from the first word, Balsamiq Sans holds one stencil-cut weight and never pinches a curve. Hanken Grotesk, a plain sans with a wire-bent look and wide channels into each counter, would feel lost if the heading shrank too small.
